goal: During an iteration the harness tracks input-side occupancy from each streamed AssistantMessage.usage (preferring the SDK get_context_usage() reading when the live client exposes it), divides it by a hybrid SDK-maxTokens/operator-context_window_tokens capacity, and emits harness.context_threshold_crossed at the first mid-turn point occupancy reaches 50%, 75%, and 90% -- staying fully inert when no capacity is available.

references: src/flywheel/harness.py:2586 -- watchdog_on_message is the existing mid-iteration on_message tap; accumulate occupancy in this same wrapper, adding NO second subscription (spec NFR Performance)

src/flywheel/harness.py:504 -- _occupancy_from_usage defines the input-side total (input + cache_read + cache_creation); reuse it on each streamed AssistantMessage.usage rather than redefining the occupancy rule

src/flywheel/harness.py:2855 -- the spec 00018 boundary recovery block reads config.context_window_tokens as the operator capacity; the mid-turn capacity is the same operator knob OR the SDK get_context_usage().maxTokens when present (hybrid)
constraints: FR-2 off by default: when NEITHER the SDK reading NOR config.context_window_tokens yields a capacity, compute no ratio, emit no events, and leave control flow byte-identical to today -- the existing tests/test_harness.py suite MUST pass unchanged.

FR-3: harness.context_threshold_crossed fires at the first message that pushes occupancy at/above each of 50%, 75%, 90%, AT MOST ONCE per tier per iteration; reset the per-tier emitted state at each new iteration. A re-cross of an already-emitted tier in the same iteration produces no duplicate.
Each event payload carries iteration, tier, occupancy tokens, capacity, computed percentage, and the capacity source ('sdk' or 'operator').

Prefer the SDK get_context_usage().totalTokens over the accumulated AssistantMessage.usage estimate for the check when the live client surfaces it (via the midturn-interrupt-seam observer); the accumulated estimate is the always-available fallback.
Emit the new event as a kind-string 'harness.context_threshold_crossed' via _emit -- do NOT add a typed events.py dataclass (spec Decisions Log).
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not interrupt the iteration or perform any recovery here -- observe only; the midturn-recovery-act task wires the interrupt-to-summarize-restart.
Do not add new HarnessConfig fields -- capacity reuses context_window_tokens and the SDK reading; the 50/75/90 tiers are fixed constants.
Do not touch thrash/hang mid-turn coverage -- out of scope, stays in _DEFERRED_LOOP_SUBSYSTEMS.
edge_cases: Capacity from operator knob only (plain query path, no client) -> observe still works via AssistantMessage.usage accumulation; source is 'operator'.
SDK reading and accumulated estimate disagree -> SDK reading wins when present, estimate is only the fallback.
Messages carry no usage and no SDK reading -> occupancy stays 0, no events (same as the 00018 'no usage data' case).
Capacity present but occupancy never reaches 50% -> no events, identical to disabled.
